instruction.name: movfr2cf
instruction.description: Move the low bit of fj into condition code cd.

latencies.notes: 1 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 10000, iters 1000. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movfr2cf $fcc0, $f0; movfr2cf $fcc1, $f1; movfr2cf $fcc2, $f2; movfr2cf $fcc3, $f3; movfr2cf $fcc4, $f4; movfr2cf $fcc5, $f5; movfr2cf $fcc6, $f6; movfr2cf $fcc7, $f7
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4' --asm 'movfr2cf $fcc0, $f0; movfr2cf $fcc1, $f1; movfr2cf $fcc2, $f2; movfr2cf $fcc3, $f3; movfr2cf $fcc4, $f4; movfr2cf $fcc5, $f5; movfr2cf $fcc6, $f6; movfr2cf $fcc7, $f7'
